name: Gravity Creative Space
description: Tel Aviv creative, design, animation and visual-effects group with roots in the mid-1990s, based at the Tel Aviv Port. Historically operated offices in New York and Los Angeles (re-launched from Rhino in 2010) and works across advertising VFX, 3D, motion graphics and compositing.
notes: Founding year conflicts: LinkedIn says 1994, trade press says 1996. US offices may no longer be active. Overlaps VFX segment.
